recommended_publication.byte_preservation: Add scoped .gitattributes with ** -text before staging archive, and byte-copy preserved originals. Emit manifest source absolute path, archive relative path, size, and SHA256. Rehash Git staged blobs against manifest; retain original absolute references, plus relocation manifest for readers. Copying does not transfer eligibility or qualification.
recommended_publication.compiled_and_runtime_artifacts: Do not commit runtime DLL/EXE/PDB/ZIP binaries. Commit build/package/qualification receipts and source plus explicit excluded-file size/hash index. Licensing and exact DLL replication are unresolved; downloaded dependencies are not necessary source changes.
recommended_publication.completion: Review diff, staged blobs, archive index and actual source-independent evidence; commit only selected paths; normal push to verified origin; record commit and remote ref identity. Native final receipts after this inventory require a create-only append in a later commit.
recommended_publication.coverage: Archive reviewed text source/proposal/review/failure/partial/accounting records and all integration mathematics artifacts. Preserve historical failed candidates and stale proposals under their original relative names; a concise index identifies the latest accepted source, actual native failure, zero updates, and mechanical-only status.
recommended_publication.method: Separate Git publication worktree/branch created from exact source eee2e0bd; preserve execution checkout HEAD and clean status throughout qualification. Publish source branch existing five commits with ordinary non-force push after live remote ancestry check. Commit evidence on publication branch; do not merge it into execution branch while grants/source snapshots bind eee2e0bd.
recommended_publication.sensitive_review: Scan eligible text before staging for real secrets, private keys, access tokens, environment dumps, user-data transcripts. Preserve essential receipts only if scan and manual review pass. Local path/PID/lease-token data are process provenance, not credentials; disclose that relocation cannot execute original source-bound packets.

risks: Source freeze/grant invalidation if execution HEAD changes during run.
Git line-ending normalization changes source/evidence hashes without scoped -text.
Historical source copies must remain labelled unqualified; a reviewed source proof does not establish native qualification.
Absolute source paths need relocation mapping, not silent rewrite.

Large repeated candidates increase repository size; include text necessary to reproduce discovery chain and preserve failed evidence, while exclude runtime copies, caches, raw datasets and model weights.
This inventory is not a full content/secret audit of all eligible files.
Remote branch status is cached and must be rechecked live before push.
scope: Read-only publication recommendation. No staging, commit, push, eligibility, grant, native execution, source edits, or candidate import.
